episodes.synopsis: Kaito is a frail boy who hunts slimes on the uppermost level of the city's dungeon. One day, he finds and defeats a glowing slime that leaves behind a very special card, changing Kaito's life forever.
episodes.title: This Nobody Will Become a Hero

episodes.synopsis: Kaito has achieved great success with his new servant and even dares to venture into the second level. However, it doesn't quite sit well with him that he cannot rely on his own strength.
episodes.title: The Second Servant Card

episodes.synopsis: Kaito has found a new servant card, and this time it's a demoness. Her bold and demanding nature surprises him and seems to meet resistance from Sylphy.
episodes.title: The Viscount-Class Devil and Sylphy's Concerns

episodes.synopsis: Kaito's now seeing diminishing returns on the experience he's getting from the monsters on floor 3, so he makes the decision to brave the floors beyond... totally unsuspecting of what he's about to find there.
episodes.title: Hidden Dungeon

episodes.synopsis: Kaito decides to take part in a dungeon event to get to know some other explorers, but he's going to have a hard time explaining that to his usual party! Meanwhile, on the surface, Haruka works up the nerve to ask Kaito... out shopping?
episodes.title: Attempting the 7th Floor! And a Date?!

episodes.synopsis: Kaito tries to convince his servants to let him form a different group. His new partners have big goals as well, and he needs to prepare for them.
episodes.title: The Doubly Dangerous 8th Floor

episodes.synopsis: Kaito takes Haruka to an open campus event at Ouka Academy, where they meet up with Airi and the rest of her party. Can Kaito manage to take a hint about how Haruka's feelings on the dungeon, much less anything else?
episodes.title: Open Campus of Adolescence

episodes.synopsis: Kaito and the girls take on floor 9 for the first time, where they're in for one nasty surprise after another.
episodes.title: Bellia the Knight-Class Devil

episodes.synopsis: Kaito and his friends join Airi at her family estate for a study session that takes a fun turn. Afterward, Kaito's party takes another stab at floor 9 and tests out the various new powers they've acquired to great success.
episodes.title: Joyful Days

episodes.synopsis: Kaito and his friends learn the truth about Hikari's condition.
episodes.title: What I Can Do Now?

episodes.synopsis: Kaito pushes himself beyond his physical limits in order to find the elixir.
episodes.title: Searching for the Elixir

episodes.synopsis: Kaito confesses to Haruka that he is afraid of going back into the dungeon. Haruka encourages him, and suddenly, Kaito gets an idea!
episodes.title: And Their Heroic Tale Begins
